tei:div.tei:p: gri 'dul mtshams sbyor nyung bsdus ni/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas ye shes kyi kā pa la stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du tshe 'das gshed ma dang bcas pa'i lan nyon gzung 'dzin bag chags kyi ngo bo la/ rnam pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi lha mnyes pa dang*/ gnod byed gri sri gri btsan thams cad 'dul ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ ā hūm̐/ gzhung ni/ me lha'i rgyal po= gyur cig bar dang*/ hūm̐/ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog bdag gi sbyin sreg ma rdzogs bar// me yi lhar ni bzhugs nas kyang*// bsreg rdzas lha yi zhal du stobs/ pad+ma sa ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ ba sa be ya raṃ swa bha wa= stong pa'i ngang las dbus kyi me dpung chen po'i klong du bh+rum̐ las dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang gi 464)dbus su che mchog yon tan gyi lha tshogs rnams gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐/ dad pa= sogs/ gsol/ rtsa sngags/ gnod byed gri sri gri btsan mā ra ya dz+wa la raṃ khā hi/ zhes btags/ na mo/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi= chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang rig sngags dang gzugs sngags dang snying po dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang*/ chos nyid gdod nas stong kyang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ khyad par du che mchog yon tan gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthu la 465) brten nas tshe las 'das pa la gson gyi bdud dang gshin gyi lcags byed pa'i za 'dre shi gshed gri sri ming sring bco brgyad/ mda' gri ltong dmar/ mdung gri sbubs dmar/ me gri tshig pa/ rta gri shun dmar/ ral gri gtub pa/

chu gri 'dar gshang*/ gad gri phyam pa/ bu gri 'gab dmar/ gri gri smug po/ thog gri tshig pa/ 'gag gri mig 'bur/ thig gri sug po/ rdo gri ldan pa/ dug gri sbos pa/ rbab gri g.yeng ba sogs gri sri gri btsan gang yin pa thams cad gzugs ling ga 'di la khug dza dzaḥ hūm̐/ chos kyi dbyings nas= che mchog= shin tu= che mchog= hūm̐/ nga ni sogs nas don bdun dang*/ hūm̐/ che mchog yab yum= sogs dang*/ mchod bstod bcas thams cad la 'gres so/ me lha la/ hūm̐/ ye shes klong 466)yangs 'khyil ba'i hom khung du// dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i mchod pa 'di// me lha drang srong 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// tshe 'das bag chags ma lus bsreg tu gsol/ oṃ ag+ne ye ha bya ka bya ba ha na ya swa hā/ gnod byed gri sri gri gshed mā ra ya phaṭa dz+wa la raṃ khā hiḥ tshangs pa 'jig rten= oṃ/ khyed kyi sems can= sangs rgyas yul du= sangs rgyas= slar yang sems can don la byon/ 'dul dkar la/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du tshe 'das de nyid gson gyi gnas skabs ji lta bar gyur/ na mo/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma mchog gsum rgyal ba rgyal mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ ngan 'gro thams cad rnam par sbyong ba bcom ldan 'das dpal chen sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen 467)po'i byin rlabs kyis/ tshe las 'das pa'i rnam par shes pa khams gsum rigs drug gi gnas gang na gnas kyang skad cig yud tsam la 'dir mchis par gyur cig nri badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ hūm̐/ dang po gri byung= mtshams su/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'dod yon lnga ldan glud gtor bzang po 'di// lha yi lan chags bu lon sbyang phyir bsngo// tshe 'das bsod nams tshogs rdzogs chos spyod cing*// rnam grol 'bras bu'i don la spyod par shog sarba bhu ta bā ling ta khā hi/ zhes sbyar/ gsal gyis gyur/

rjes su/ hūm̐/ chos kyi dbyings kyi thab khung du// bdag 'dzin phung po'i bud shing la// shes rab ye shes me sbar te// tshe 'das nyon mongs bag chags bsreg /'di ni skye 'gag smon pa dang*// gnas med mtshan ma med pa'i me// 'di ni 468)rang byung ye shes me// bdag 'dzin mtshan ma'i rtog pa bsreg /don la sreg bya bsreg byed kun// bya rtsol med par ye sangs rgyas// 'bad med lhun grub chos kyi sku// rang byung ye shes der snang ngo*/ rtsa sngags/ ag+ne dz+wa la raṃ/ dkon mchog= sogs mthar dbyung ngo*/ pad+ma ma ṇis bris pa'o// 469) ༄༅/ gri 'dul mtshams sbyor shin tu bsdus pa/ bsreg tu gsol/ rtsa sngags/ gnod byed gri sri gri gshed mā ra ya phaṭaḥ dz+wa la raṃ khā hi/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*// rtsa ba gsum gyi byin rlabs dang*// mkha' 'gro chos skyong nus mthu yis// gnod byed gri sri gri btsan dang*// gson bdud gshin lcags gang yin rnams// myur du khug la thim par mdzod/ hūm̐/ rdo rje phur pa kī la ya// sangs rgyas yongs rdzogs phrin las thun// dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog hūm̐ che mchog yab yum sogs nas sbrel/ bka' srung mthar/ bstod pa/ yang dag 'jam dpal gshin rje pad+ma dbang*// rdo rje gzhon nu bla med he ru ka /che mchog rig 'dzin dregs 'dul drag sngags sogs// bka' brgyad lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ me lha gtang rag man 'dra'o// pad+ma ma ṇis so// 470) 471) ༄༅/ 'chi bslu mdor bsdus bya na/ dri zan las glud dang chang bu ril bu lo grangs sam ci rigs la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du/ glud gtor 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pas nam mkha' gang bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum dang*/ hoḥ sa brlabs/ sarba bhu ta a kar+sha ya dzaḥ sa mgron 'gugs/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te oṃ saṃ bhā ra saṃ bhā ra hūm̐/

de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang sogs bzhi'i mtshan dang*/ hūm̐/ khyer cig khyer cig stobs ldan rnams// sred dang chags dang zhen pa dang*// dran dang bzung dang bsam dang reg /glod dang zhi dang grol bar mdzod/ ces pas glud gtor re re bzhin bsngos nas/ grangs rdzogs pa dang*/ lo bdud thog tu bskyal te/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ bi shwa badz+ra sogs kyis khro tshogs bskul nas/ hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod cing gu gul bdug yungs thun gyis brabs pas 472) 'chi bdag bgegs kyis tshogs rnams rgyang ring du bskrad nas srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom cing shis pa brjod pa rnams bya'o// pad+ma ma ṇis so// 473)༄༅/ zhi khro ngan song sbyong ba btang lugs ni/ rtsa gtor/ skong chog gtor ma rgyas par/ zhi gtor zhe gnyis/ drag gtor lnga bcu nga brgyad/ 'bring po zhi gtor bzhi/ drag gtor drug bsdu na/ zhi gtor gcig la pad+ma'i tshab ril bu zhe gnyis sbyar ba dang*/ drag gtor gcig la mtheb skyu lnga bcu nga brgyad sbyar ba/ dkar bgegs/ chad brtan/ cha gsum/ tshogs gnyis/ gsol ka gnas 'dren la zhi sbyong pad sbubs gsum/ phyed ma zan kong gsum/ lan chags gsum/ zas bsngo/ gtso las bum pa/ me long*/ byang bu bcas 'du bya/ cho ga dngos la/ sems bskyed sdom chog tshig bdun/ sku gsum/ chos sku= 'di ltar= sogs shwo lo ka bzhi/ 'dzam gling= sogs shwo lo ka drug e ma ho: rgya chad phyogs lhung= badz+ra ma ha shrī= bdag nyid= dkar gtor/ zhi rol/ dkar/ sarba bhu ta= sarba big+nan= gsum/ yo ga kho nas/ hūm̐/ nyon cig= brlag par gyur/ zhi rol/ dung chen ṇir/ bgegs gtor 'phen/ sngags 474) zhi rol/ rkang bzhi/ bgegs bdug yungs thun/ bgegs rnams= oṃ badz+ra= gang bar gyur/ zhi rol/ dkar/ rgya/ dung*/ ḍā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa= gsum/ ma hā ba ling+ta te dzo= gsum/ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la= gsum/ rang gi snying ga'i= zhi khro sgyu 'phrul rnam par rol pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad=

pha mas= gsum/ chos thams cad= gsum/ sems can thams cad= gsum/ dzaḥhūm̐= tshogs zhing= oṃ ma hā shu n+ye= gsal bar gyur/ khrus gdangs/ lhug res mos/ bdag dang= e ma= mtshar lnga/ dngos rnams= de ni= dngos po= sems nyid= 'phro 'dus= yo ga dril med/ rang gi sems nyid= sman gdangs/ mu tig phreng ba= man lhug 'don dal/ lha bskyed yongs rdzogs/ gzhan yang dkyil 'khor= sman gdangs/ de ltar= yan lhug byin rlabs/ dbang bskur/ spyan 'dren gdangs chen/ ma lus sems can= zhi rol/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ rkang bzhi/ ḍā/ yo ga bzhi dril/ ye shes sprul pa'i= bzhugs gsol/ phyag snang mchod/ 475) shab+da= zhi rol/ rgya/ dung/ dkar/ ḍā/ stong mchod/ zung 'jug zhog tshogs grol/ ༈ dril stabs phyag rgyas/ yo gas bstod/ rnam snang thugs kyi= lhug bho dhi= sum brgya/ dkyil 'khor gtso bo rnam snang ljags= rdo rje= ru lu= sum brgya/ thugs kar sngags phreng 'khor ba las 'od zer= durga te= brgya/ bdag gi thugs= dbyangs gsal sham can brgya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lha 'od du zhu nas bum chu bdud rtsir gyur/ bum sgrub 'di rigs la gtso bum steng dung chu/ de steng gzungs rdor bzhag skud pa'i sne slaub dpon la phul/ bsnyen pa tshar ran dus gzungs thag bsdu/ dung chu bum par blugs/ kha rgyan rnams 'dzugs dgos/ mdun bskyed kyi= yig brgya brgya/ gnas 'dren gyi las bum/ dung chu gzungs rdor sngar ltar/ shu n+ye ta= bum pa= ma lus= yo ga zhi rol/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ rkang bzhi/ ḍā/ yo ga bcom ldan= dngos su= shab+da= zhi rol/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ ḍā/ chos sku= rang zhi khro'i= 476)khengs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swa hāḥ stong*/ āḥ khri/ oṃ a bh+ya 'de taṃ kaṃ= gsham can sum brgya/ pad+ma rgyas pa= zhi rol bzhi/ brjod med= yig brgya/ a āḥ lha 'od du zhu nas bum chu bdud rtsir gyur/ tsha rting grol/ a la la hoḥ chos rnams= lhug āḥbadag nyid= yig brgya brgya/ hoḥthugs rje chen po= āḥ'akhor 'das=

'a a= sum brgya/ hoḥdagongs shig= hoḥsnang srid= yo ga bzhi dril/ bh+yo bi shwa= gsum/ mchod gzungs/ zhi rol/ rgya/ dkar/ dung*/ rdor sems bskangs gdangs/ lhug re mos/ sman/ zhi rol/ rak+ta/ zhi rol/ gtor ma/ zhi rol/ tshogs zhus/ yo ga bzhi dril kho nas/ tshogs byin rlabs/ zhi rol/ spyan 'dren/ zhi rol/ rkang bzhi/ ḍā/ mchod pa/ zhi rol/ bar bshags/ nri tri badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ hūm̐:ma rig= zhi rol/ dung*/ rkang*/ tshogs drang ba/ bsam lhun/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus= lhag zhus/ byin rlabs/ zhi 477) rol/ dung dkar/ rnga/ lhag ma yo ga zhi rol/ rkang*/ dung*/ dkar/ ḍā/ bskang gdangs/ mar me/ zhi rol/ smon lam/ lhug hoḥmachod du= bskang gdangs/ zhi rol/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ ḍā/ gung tshigs grol/ ༈ bar tshogs dang po la/ lha bskyed/ shu n+ye ta= snang srid 'khor 'das kyi bsdus pa'i= dran rdzogs su gsal bar gyur/ oṃ/ ma lus sems can= spyan 'dren nas sngar ltar bsnyen bstod 'od zhu bcas/ gsol ka yongs rdzogs/ tshogs grol/ ༈ bar tshogs gnyis pa la/ phyag 'tshal/ yig brgya/ smre bshags/ lta ba'i klong bshags/ dong sprugs/ spyi bshags/ kun bzang*/ sman/ raka gtor/ tshogs rlab drangs mchod/ bshags/ bstab/ drang ba/ cha gsum/ lhag ma bcas/ gnas 'dren gyi/ stong pa'i ngang las= na mo/ rje btsun= gsum/ rnam pa shes= shwa dha ni= gsum/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ sarba bhigh+nān= gsum/ sum bha ni= gsum/ tshe las= zhi rol/ rkang*/ dung*/ tshe las 'das pa'i spyi bor= yo ga 'di 478)ni bzod pa'i= dug khrus rol mo/ (Musical notes and signs here) pad skor dang*/ bzhi ldeb bcas/ rol nang*/ āḥbacu gsham can lo grangs/ de'i 'gres/ mgrin par/ gsang gnas/ mchan g.yas/ spyi bo/ snying ga bum gdangs/ dbang bskur rdo rje= yig brgya/ dril bsil/ dbang bskur nas/ zas sngo/ a ka ro= 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin zas// dmigs yul rigs kyi bu khyod kyang*// zas mchog 'di la longs spyod nas// sbyin pa zas kyi 'tsho bar shog

tshul khrims/ bzod pa/ brtson 'grus/ bsam gtan/ shes rab/ yo ga bzhi dril/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'gro ba rigs drug= bsgrod nus par gyur cig thams cad nam mkha'i= yo ga bzhi dril/ bla mas gsungs/ kyai/ tshe las= bzhud cig= spro na/ btags grol dpal gyi gdub bu'i sngags tshang ma thams cad kyis phyogs 'don/ bsdu na/ 'a a ha sha sa maḥ gsum/ gshin rje'i pho nyas= yo ga bzhi dril/ dkon mchog rin chen= bcas/ bla mas/ ho/ rig pa dbang gi= song zhig rnam shes hūm̐ gi rnam pas 479)zhing khams de dag tu gshegs par gyur/ grol nyin byang sreg zhor/ bskang gdangs kyis mar me'i skong ba/ smon lam/ lta ba'i skong ba bcas/ tshogs grol/ ༈ dgung tshogs la/ gsol ka bskyang*/ bskul pa yo ga zhi rol/ dkar/ dung*/ bstan ma yo ga'am rang gdangs/ zhi rol/ rgya/ dung dkar/ bro/ mchod pa/ dngos su= zhi rol/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ ḍā/ brjod med= bstod/ bshags pa yig brgya/ grol nyin dngos grub zhi rol/ dkar/ dung*/ rgya/ rten bzhugs/ bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon gsum/ bkra sis rang gdangs/ zhi rol brgyud gsum phyed bcas snga phyi gnyis/ rkang*/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ ḍā/ bcas/ bzang spyod sogs spyi ltar/ pad+ma ma ṇis so// 480) 481) ༄༅/ zhi bsang bsdus pa bzhugs/ hūm̐: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: bla ma dkon mchog la sogs pa: srid zhu'i mgron du gyur pa rnams: mchod pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no: g.yu shug phye mar gsur gyis mchod: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod: yams nad rims nad zhi bar mdzod: blo gor hon gsum zhi bar mdzod: rlung mkhris bad kan zhi bar mdzod= pho gdon mo gdon zhi bar mdzod= zhi ba'i las kun bsgrub tu gsol: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs pa: yon tan mgron du gyur pa rnams: mchod pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no: g.yu shug= nad gdon= yams nad= glo gor= rlung mkhris= pho gdon= zhi ba'i= dad pa dag ni dam tshig gis: 'gro ba rigs drug la sogs pa:

snying rje'i mgron du gyur pa rnams: mchod pa'i gnas 'dir= 482) g.yu= nad= yams= glo= rlung= pho= zhi ba'i las= dad pa dag ni dam tshig gis: bi na ya ka la sogs pa'i: lan chags mgron du gyur pa rnams: mchod pa'i= g.yu shug= nad gdon= yams nad= glo gor hon gsum zhi bar mdzod: rlung mkhris bad kan= pho gdon mo gdon= zhi ba'i las kun bsgrub tu gsol: nad thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: gdon thams cad shin+taṃ ku tu ye swā hā: bar chad thams cad= yams nad thams cad= rims nad thams cad= 'gos nad thams cad= glo shin+taṃ= gor shan+tiṃ= hon= rlung= mkhris pa= bad kan= 'dus pa= pho gdon rgyal po= mo gdon gsen mo= klu gdon the rang= oṃ ar+kha ni swā hā: nir+kha ni= gho gha le= ya ma na ye= sa ma ya swā hā: ha ka la= shan+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā:

zhes dpal chen 'dus pas so// ༈ sde brgyad mchod pa bsdus pa bzhugs so/ hūm̐/ sku gsum brgyud gsum 483)bla ma dang*// yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang*/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po dang*// mkha' 'gro nor lha chos skyong sogs// mchod yul gong ma thams cad la// mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo// gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la// bdag gi 'dod don bsgrub tu gsol/ /phyi nang gsang mchog sprul pa dang*// gab sbas rtag chags g.yang gter dang*// las myur 'gyogs dang drag po sngags// bstan srung gnod sbyin bye brag sogs// snang srid sde brgyad 'khor bcas la// mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo// gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la// bdag gi 'dod don bsgrub tu gsol/ rig 'dzin dpal chen 'dus pa rtsal gyi phyag bris las bshus so// 484) 485)༄༅/ bka' brgyad khro gsang gtor bzlog dang gri 'dul bcas kyi las 'grigs bzhugs so/ 486) ༄༅/ na mo shri badz+ra dha ra ye/ ye shes klong dgu'i rol gar las/ sgrub sde dgu yi tshom bu shar// bka' brgyad bla ma dbyer med la// gus pas 'dud do gnang ba stsol/ de la 'dir sgrub chen bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi gtor bzlog 'don 'grigs khyab bdag bla ma kun bzang shes rab yab sras rnams kyi phyag bzhes ltar 'god pa la/ thog mar gnam chos rtsa gsum las byang la bka' brgyad lus dkyil sbyar ba'i bsnyen bstod yan grub nas/ sa chog gi don du gtor ma cha gsum ni/ oṃ 487)swa bha wa= oṃ āḥhūm̐/ thugs ka nas sa bon= sogs nas/ pham rgyal med par thob par bsam/ sngags drug phyag drug oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ bh+rum̐ zhes pas gzhal yas su byin gyis rlabs so/ oṃ a pra ti= sogs nas mgron bskyed/ sngags dang tshigs bcad kyi spyan drangs/ sa ma s+t+waṃ/ brten du/ oṃ pra ma na ye sur+ya sa ma ya/ de'i 'gres kyi gong gi sngags rnams kyi nang*/

hūm̐ badz+ra= zhes pa dang*/ a gad dza= 488) sogs dor nas de'i tshab du/ sa ma ya= sbyar bas dam la bzhag mchod pa'i don du sngags gong ma la/ sa ma ya= sbyar ba'i don du/ i dan gh+ri na= sogs so sor mjug sbyar ba'am/ sngags yongs rdzogs mjug tu lan gcig sbyar na chog a ka ro= dang*/ hūm̐/ dpal mgon bstan pa= sogs nas/ mchis par mdzod/ bar dang*/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i chos sbyin gsum brjod/ sngon gyi dam bcas= sogs nas/ phrin las mdzod/ bar dang*/ gong gi sngags rnams la/ gats+tsha= sbyar bas gtor ma dang po gshegs/ gtor ma gnyis pa/ swa bha wa= oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ a nri su tri= hūm̐/ srid pa'i rtse mo= nas/ myur du 'dus/ sngags gong mar/ a nri su tri= brjod/ na ma sarba= sogs nas/ smon du shog bar 'og gi chos sbyin gsum dang bden stobs bcas/ a nṛ su tri pre du gats+tsha= gshegs/ gtor ma gsum pa ni/ swa bha wa= oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum/ rang nyid rta mgrin du gsal la/ hūm̐/ lha klu= sogs nas chos sbyin gsum bden stobs bcas grub zin nas/ gang zhig mtshan mo= sogs nas/ gdon rnams rang gi gnas su 489)song/ bar spyi ltar/ hūm̐/ dam tshig bden la= sogs nas gats+tsha= bar/ sum bha ni sa bgegs bskrad/ 'byung po gang dag= sogs brjod/ ༈ rgyan bkod kyi don du gtsang gyer/ ( 'ur sum brdung*/ rnga rab 'udar dgu brdung*/ ) gzhal yas don bstod/ ( 'ur rkang bdun brdung*/ ) byin 'bebs ( sngags rnams rnga bkyags/ 'ur rkang bdun gsum/ 'ur gsum brdung*/ ) gtor bsngo bskang thung mchod bstod yan spyi ltar bya'o/ ༈ dngos gzhi la/ hrīḥsngon= mchod rlabs/ spos phyung*/ skyabs yul ni/ stong pa'i ngang las= bca' 'o/ ( 'ur sum brdung ) skyabs sems/ bla ma sangs rgyas= nas/ gsal stong sgom/ ( snga ma gnyis la sum brdung re/ ) bar lan gsum/ bla ma bde gshegs= nas yan lag bcu pas maṇ+ḍal/ ( sum brdung*/ ) ye a hūm̐/ 'ur sum brdung*/ yan/ dkar gtor bkra shis rgya mtshos mdzad pa cha tshang*/

mtshams lha bskyed pa/ swa bha wa= nas/ he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭaḥ bar dang*/ bgegs gtor/ hrīḥpad+ma ta krita= nas/ sum brdung*/ gats+tsha= bar dang*/ las byang dang sbrel na/ ( sum brdung*/ ) hūm̐: yang dag don la= nas/ brlag: bar gzhung gis/ hūm̐: rgyal ba 490)zhi khro= nas hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags dang*/ bgegs rdung*/ mtshon cha'i mtshams gcod/ dz+wa la ram̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ 'phros 'phyang gi khro bcu/ hūm̐/ steng phyogs= nas/ s+pho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ bar sbyar/ gzhung gi hūm̐: dregs pa lha chen= sogs nas/ khro bo rol pa'i bsrung 'khor/ ha la hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ( 'ur sum brdung*/ ) bar/ 'phyang gi yan lag bcu pa/ hūm̐:bla ma yi dam= nas/ mngon gyur shog: bar 'dzud/ gzhung gi brda sgo/ hūm̐: snang srid thams cad= nas brda phyag dam bca'/ ( rol bsu 'ur bdun brdung*/ ) byin 'bebs/ ( rkang 'ur bdun brdung*/ ) mchod rlabs/ sa ma ya swā hāḥ 'phros 'phyang gi bshags pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: bla ma rig 'dzin= nas yig brgya yan/ gzhung gi bshags pa/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam= nas/ de ting*/ rgyu ting*/ kun ting*/ 'byung rim/ gzhal yas/ lha bskyed/ sa ma ya hoḥ rjes su mdun bskyed ho pas mdzad pa las/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal= nas/ gzugs can du= bsam/ 'dir bsad pa las bcu'i 'gugs pa sbyar/ oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka ma traṃ ru tra a 491)kar+sha ya= sogs nas/ khrol gyi zhig pa las: bar/ 'dir mdun bskyed rgyas pa gter gzhung khang khyim brgyad pa/ yang na/ bh+rum̐ bhi shwa bhi shud+dhe= nas/ dpal gyi chas brgyad kyi brgyan par bya'o/ bar dang*/ 'khor bskyed he pa'i lhan thabs sbyar na/ shar phyogs kyi gzhal yas= sogs nas/ khril sbyor du gnas pa'o/ bar ram gter gzhung nang gi lhag 'phros btang kyang chog rgyas bsdus gang ltar yang*/ de rgyab phyi rim lcags ri nag po= sogs nas/ spyan drangs la so sor stim= bar gtong ba'am/ bsdu na he pa'i mdun bskyed gzhung rgyug ltar bya/ khrol gyi zhig pa las= 'phros su/ e maṇ+ḍal la= sogs bskul btab bar btang yang chog

las byang gi hūm̐:rang byung dkyil 'khor= sogs nas byin brlabs/ dbang bskur ( rkang 'ur gsum/ ) spyan 'dren ( 'ur rkang gsum/ ) bzhugs gsol/ phyag rgya ( tshig mtha' rnga bkyags/ ) glu/ rnam lnga/ nang*/ ( 'ur gsum/ ) gsang*/ ( 'ur gsum/ ) sha khrag ( 'ur gsum/ ) sman mchod/ sarba pañtsa= rnga bkyags/ kha raṃ kha hiḥ 'phros 'phyang ga rdo rje dbyings kyi= nas/ kha hiḥ bar dang*/ gzhung gi 492)hūm̐/ lce yi dam tshig nas/ dngos grub/ gtor ma/ rak+ta/ gsang bsnan/ sbyor sgrol mchod pa/ ( dgu brdung*/ ) bstod pa/ oṃ na ma= bar dang*/ tshom bu dgu bstod dang*/ gtum chen gang rung*/ sbyar/ gzhung gi bshags pa/ hūm̐:zhi khro= nas yig brgya yan/ ( 'ur sdum brdung*/ ) brgyud 'debs sbyar/ 'dzab bskul/ ( ḍā 'ur/ ) 'dzab 'don/ hūm̐:gsang ba yongs rdzogs nas= mi gtong ngo: bar dang*/ ( 'ur dgu bcas/ ) zhi ba rigs brgya'i bsnyen pa/ a li ka li= brgya/ zhi ba zhe gnyis bsnyen pa/ bho dhi tsit+ta= brgya/ de nyid rigs lnga'i bsnyen pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hāḥ brgya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bde gshegs zhi ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du= sarba pañtsa ba ling+ta rak+ta= hūm̐:zhi ba'i lha tshogs= sogs 'og tu 'byung ba ltar brjod/ ( gnam chos mchod rol/ ) gzhung gi/ mtshan 'bum rta/ hūm̐:dbus phyogs= sogs gtso bsnyen lnga brgya/ stong tshig ( rol re thar ma 'dra/ ) sngar ltar kha bsgyur/ hūm̐:shar phyogs 'khor lo'i= nas/ dpal brgyad kyi bsnyen pa brgya rtsa re/ bka' bsdod la lnga bcu/ stong tshig kha bsgyur 493) bcas so sor sbyar/ drag sngags so lnga la sum brgya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐:dpal chen yongs rdzogs= sogs nas/ stong tshig sngar ltar/ ( rol/ ) drag sngags las srung gsham/ zhi rgyas dbang drag rnams kyi gsham sbyar gsum re dang*/ thun rdzas byin rlabs/ 'grub par gyur cig dbyangs gsal/ yig brgya/ brten snying*/ ḍā bcas/ hūm̐: spos dang me tog= sogs kyis mchod/ ( 'ur/ ) hūm̐: bde gshegs thams cad=

sogs bstod/ gzhung gi hūm̐:lha dang rig 'dzin= sogs nas/ sid+dhi hūm̐ āḥ ( 'ur/ ) bar gyi dngos grub blang*/ hrīḥdage ba 'di yi= ( rnga bcad/ ) sogs kyis dge bsngo bya'o/ ma ning*/ dregs gsol/ ( sum brdung*/ ) hūm̐:chos rnams kun gyi= sogs nas/ ( spyan 'dren mgor rkang 'ur sum brdung*/ mchod pa'i mtha' 'ur dgu brdung*/ ) yak+sha nag po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: bar/ ( sum rdung*/ ) gzhung gi tshogs byin rlabs/ oṃ u tsu= sogs nas/ oṃ aḥhūm̐: bar dang*/ 'phyang gi ( rkang 'ur sum brdung*/ ) hūm̐:rdo rje dbyings kyi= sogs nas/ dngos grub stsol: bar/ ( rkang 'ur sum brdung*/ ) gzhung gi rgyal 494)ba zhi khro= sogs nas/ thugs dam bskang: bar dang*/ skong rjas byin rlabs/ ( rkang 'ur sum brdung*/ ) bla ma yongs rdzogs skong ba/ ( 'ur sum brdung*/ ) mdangs bskang rgyas pa dang*/ ( don drug ma/ ) 'gur lugs gsum 'don res/ 'dir las mtha' dregs pa nyi shu'i rlung 'khor sbrel tshe/ de'i bskang ba/ ( sum gnyis/ ) hūm̐:lcang lo can gyi= sogs tshang bar btang*/ gzhung gi tshogs mchod/ bla med mchog gi= nas/ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: rjes gnam chos bskang thung sbyar/ bar bshags/ hūm̐:ma rig bag chags= nas/ sa ma ya ho: gang gi che bskyed/ hūm̐: snang srid thams cad= nas/ bzlog bh+yo= bar dang*/ rjes su/ tshogs snod de nyid= ( dgu brdung*/ ) dang*/ spyi 'gugs/ ( rgyob sod dgu brdung*/ ) phur thun mtshams bskul ni/ zor rta/ hūm̐:chos kyi dbyings nas= sogs dang*/ hūm̐:rdo rje phur pa= sogs nas/ ( rgyab sod dgu brdung*/ ) ma ra ya rbad: lhu gcig sbyar bas bsgral/ 'phyang gi hūm̐:bde gshegs zhi ba'i lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: gzhung gi dpal chen yongs rdzogs lha tshogs= 495) nas/ bstab: ( rgyob sod dgu brdung*/ ) hūm̐: zhal zas tshogs= drang ba dang*/ lhag ma byin rlabs nas/ ( rkang 'ur bdun brdung*/ ) hūm̐:chos dbyings rnam dag= nas/ sa ma ya: lhag ma spyir btang*/

de dag gis bstod las grub/ ༈ smad las gyi gser skyems/ mchod pa phud skong ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra rat+na= nas/ dngos grub stsol: bar/ he pa'i 'dod gsol che ba ni/ hūm̐/ dgongs su gsol/ dur khrod chos 'byung= sogs dang*/ dkon mchog gsum po bdag la= sogs/ gnyis re mos/ bdag cag rnal 'byor pa'i= man/ rgyas bsdus gnyis ka la sbyar srol 'dug mkhyen gsos/ hūm̐ bh+yo: gdod nas ma skyes= sogs dang*/ gzu dpang*/ 'gro ba'i don mdzad= sogs nas/ bsam pa sgrubs: bar btang*/ bskul pa ni/ ( skang 'ur dgu/ ) hūm̐:mi mngon 496)dbyings nas= sogs/ bcom ldan 'das= ( mtshams kyi tshig lhug rnams la rnga re re tsam/ mthar 'ur dgu dan re/ mthar 'ur dgu brdung*/ mthar dbyung*/ ) 'phros su spyi bskul 'bring po sbyar na 'di skabs 'dzud/ rgyas 'bring gnyis re mos btang*/ mchod byang*/ bdag nyid dpal chen po= sogs dang*/ phung por bsam/ bar dang spyan 'dren/ ( rkang 'ur sum brdung*/ ) hūm̐: dad pa dang ni= sogs nas/ mdzod/ bar dang*/ pho nya dgos bskul rgyas pa/ ( rkang 'ur dgu brdung*/ ) hūm̐:shar phyogs khyab par= sogs nas/ mtshom bu dgu ka la/ che mchog yon tan bka' bsrung rnams: 'dod yon= bcol ba'i= zhes kha bsgyur la sbyar/ sgos bskul bsdus pa/ hūm̐: zhi khro bka' brgyad= sogs btang yang chog rgyas bsdus gnyis kar/ hūm̐:pho nya yongs rdzogs= ( dgra srog dmar po mgor rnga bkyags/ ) man sbyar srol 'dug dmod byang spro na/ hūm̐:rdo rje slob dpon= nas tshang bar btang*/ ( rgyob sod dgu brdung*/ ) ༈ bsad pa las bcu'i/ e ma dha la= sogs/ brub bskyed/ mkhyen gsol/ 497)( dgu brdung*/ ) 'gugs pa gsum spyi ltar/ bden chung dgu rtsa brgyud gsum 'phros/ e yi tshogs kyi= nas/ pho nya/ lha dbye/ bskul pa/ nyes bsgrags ( dgu brdung*/ 'di man zor rta/ ) phur bsgril/ rnam shes spar ba/ gzugs phung du bsam= ( la rgyob sod bsad brdung ya/

) 'phros phur thun mtshams bskul mtha' bar btang*/ ( rgyob sod bsad brdung ya/ ) hūm̐:lcags sam= sogs nas/ phur pa gdab/ ( rgyob sod bsad brdung cha gcig ) gris gtub/ gtun rdung*/ ( rgyob sod bsad brdung cha gnyis/ ) zhal bstab/ sgrub par bsam= bar/ zhi bzlog tshang bar btang*/ gtor bzlog ( rkang 'ur dgu brdung*/ ) hūm̐: bcom ldan dpal chen tshogs= sogs nas/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad dgra bgegs dmag tshogs bzlog: bar/ mdun du nya bo= sogs tshig bzhi/ rtsa brgyud/ ( rgyob sod dgu brdung*/ ) hūm̐:yon tan rgyud las= sogs phur btab lhu gcig zor rtas/ hūm̐:che mchog sprul pa'i= sogs gris btub/ ( bsad brdung ya/ ) hūm̐:smug nag gru gsum= 498) sogs dmar sbreng lhu cig hūm̐:che mchog yon tan= btab pa/ 'di rol cig: 'phros bzlog pa'i/ ( rnga bkyags/ ) smug nag gru gsum= nas/ khā hi: bar dang*/ hūm̐:dpal gyi gtor ma= sogs nas gtor 'bul/ hūm̐:che mchog yon tan lha tshogs sras: bcol gtad/ hūm̐ bh+yo:nga ni= sogs/ ( rgyob sod dgu brdung*/ ) bh+yo gdab bcas dpal dgu/ bka' bsdod/ phur gdab ( bsad rdung ya/ ) bcas so sor 'gres sbyar ( gri gtub la bsad brdung cha gnyis/ ) khyung gi sa ma s+t+waṃ= 'phros su/ ( rol bsu 'ur sum brdung*/ ) hūm̐: dad pa dag ni= sogs spyan 'dren dang*/ rgyal mtsho klu dbang= sogs bzhugs phyag dang*/ hūm̐: snang srid 'dod yon= sogs mchod bstod/ phrin las mdzod: 'phros bzlog pa'i/ khroṃ ga ru= nas/ brlag par bsam/ ( dgu brdung*/ ) bar che mchog yon tan bzlog pa tshang bar ( dgu brdung*/ ) btang*/ 'phros bzlog pa grangs gsog na/ hūm̐: bcom ldan dpal chen= sogs/ dpal dgu bka' bsdod khyung bcas gzhung 'gros sbyar/ ) nub rnams su 499)( rkang 'ur dgu ) bden stobs bzlog pa/ ( dgu brdung*/ sde brgyad dril bzlog tsam rjes su/ ( rgyob sod dgu brdung*/ ) dkar gtor/ ( dgu ) rtsa rgyud/

( rgyob sos dgu brdung*/ ) las byang chad tho ( dgu ) bstan ma spyi ltar/ bro mnan spyi ltar/ khro rol las byang mthar mchod bstod/ 'phyang gi tshe 'gugs/ hūm̐:rgyal ba zhi khro= nas/ bkra shis mthar/ shis brjod ci rigs/ hūm̐: bsod nams ye shes= nas/ mthar phyin shog: bar/ las byang gi dbyangs gsal yig brgya lan gsum/ rten snying*/ bdag dang 'gro la= sogs sam/ hūm̐:dang po chos sku= bdag bskyed ma lus= sogs/ klong du bsdu'o/ bar dang*/ hūm̐: ngar 'dzin rnam dag= sogs/ badz+ra shrī= bar/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor= sogs/ bsngo smon ci rig brjod/ ༈ bsdus pa'i lugs ni/ hrīḥsngon= spos phyung*/ ( 'ur sum brdung*/ ) skyabs sems sogs tshigs bcad/ bgegs gtor las byang*/ hūm̐: rgyal ba zhi khro= nas gzhung 'gros/ sa ma hoḥ rjes/ bsad pa las bcu'i/ mdun gyi liṅga= sogs nas/ 'khor dang bcas pa bskyed/ bar/ 500) las byang dbang bskur nas gzhung 'gros bstod bshags/ 'dzab bskul/ zhi bsnyen stong tshig dbus phyogs= gtso bsnyen/ stong tshig hūm̐:shar lho= dpal brgyad bsnyen pa stong*/ stong tshig ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yang dag thugs/ 'jam dpal sku/ pad+ma gsung*/ phur pa phrin las/ ma mo rbod gtong*/ bla ma rig 'dzin/ 'jig rten mchod bstod/ dmod pa drag sngags kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du sarba pañtsa bha ling+ta rak+ta= hūm̐/ yang dag lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs// 'jam dpal= sogs gzhan rnams la 'gres/ drag sngags= mthar/ phyi nang gsang ba'i= sogs/ 'phros/ hūm̐:yang sprul= sogs/ bsnyen pa'i rjes stong tshig sngar ltar/ ༈ gter gzhung ltar na/ 'dzab bskul zhi bsnyen/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā pañtsa= sogs/ ye shes= stong tshig bya/ hūm̐:dbus phyogs= sogs/ gtso bsnyen/ stong tshig de ltar/ dpal brgyad bsnyen pa/ bka' bsrung*/ drag sngags/ bsrung ba/ zhi rgyas dbang drag rjes mchod bstod/ dngos grub/ dge bsngo sngar ltar/ 501) dregs pa/ tshogs gzhung 'gros/ bskang bsdus cig

mchod bshags stab gsum/ drang lhag bcas/ phud skong*/ gzu dpang*/ spyi bskul/ sgos bskul/ ༈ bsad pa las bcu/ gtor bzlog gzhung rgyug byas pas mthus/ ༈ nyin phyi ma rnams la/ bden dril bzlog gsum rjes su bong khyung dregs gsum btang lugs ni/ bong zhon las/ hūm̐/ dam rdzas thun zlog gi gtor ma= sogs nas/ byed par bsam mo/ ( rkang 'ur dgu bar*/ ) khyung gi hūm̐:dad pa= nas khro rgyal khams gsum 'go bar/ gong gi sngags/ badz+ra pa ṇi= sogs sngags ring thung dgu tsam/ bong zhon ma'i/ hūm̐/ nga ni che mchog= nas mtha' bar/ khyung gi khro rgyal nas= mthar/ dregs pa'i/ swa bha wa= sogs dang*/ gtor ma mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las 'og gzhi gru gsum nas/ bsam pa'i steng du/ dbang phyug ma hā de ba= nas/ gsol bar bsam/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ bh+rum̐ las= nas mtha' bar/ dregs bskul/ 502)( rkang 'ur dgu ) bcom ldan thugs kyi= nas mtha' bar/ ( dgu ) dregs zlog hūm̐ bh+yo dza: snang srid= nas/ ( rgyob sod dgu brdung*/ ) mtha' bar btang*/ ( zor dbang sbyar mtshan/ ) ༈ khro rol las byang bde chen rab gsal ltar gtong na/ hrīḥsngon= spos phyung*/ lhan thabs kyi nang*/ ( 'ur sum brdung*/ ) na mo/ sangs rgyas chos= sogs/ de nas skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed/ yan lag brgyad pa/ mngon gyur shog bar/ ( gang gi bdag ) bdag nyid skad cig= sogs nas/ mdun du bkug bar/ bgegs gtor btang*/ hūm̐:yang dag don= hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags bcas/ ( bgegs brdung*/ ) 'og gi ston pa'i bka' nyon= nas/ tri yaṃ phaṭaḥ bar/ las byang gi bdag nyid las kyi= nas/ mtshams lha/ ( 'ur sum brdung*/ ) brda sgo brda phyag mdam bca'/ byin 'bebs/ ( rkang 'ur nun/ ) mchod rlabs/ ( sum brdung*/ ) ting 'dzin rnam gsum/ tsit+ta hūm̐: bar/ lhan thabs kyi/ e las 'byung ba= nas/ mtha' bar/ las byang gi hūm̐:shar phyogs 'khor lo= nas/ sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ 503) bar/ ( sum brdung*/ ) bsad pa las bcu'i/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal=

nas/ 'gugs pa sbyar zhing*/ dpal gyi bka' bsrung rnams bskyed do/ bar/ 'dir gsang rdzogs mdun bskyed sbyar kyang chog las byang gi ( rnga bcas/ ) hūm̐:bdag nyid dus gsum= ( rkang 'ur gsum/ ) spyan 'dren/ ( rkang 'ur gsum/ ) bzhugs gsol/ phyag 'tshal/ mchod pa rnam lnga la/ zhi ba/ dpal dgu/ bka' srung bcas kyi sngags so sor gsham sbyar ba'am/ spyan 'dren gsal ba ltar bya/ ( 'ur dgu brdung*/ ) bstod pa'i rjes/ ( dgu brdung*/ gsum/ ) 'og gi bshags pa/ hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs= sogs/ ( 'ur gsum/ ) rgyud 'debs/ 'dzab bskul/ sngags so sor/ stong tshig 'bul lugs gsang rdzogs ltar bya/ dregs gsol gter bdag gling pa'i gsung rgyun ltar 'don/ las byang tshogs/ ( sum brdung*/ ) nyon cig= nas/ byin rlabs/ ( rkang 'ur gsum/ ) spyan 'dren rjes/ ( rkang 'ur gsum yang rkang gnyis/ ) 'gugs pa/ ( rgyob sod dag ) ུ bsgral btab/ ( rgyob sod dgu ) bskang zhing bshags par bsam= ( rkang 'ur gsum/ ) skong chen/ zhi ba/ dpal dgu bka' bsdod bcas so 504) so'i mthar/ 'gres byang rnams ( rnga bkyags ) zhi khro ltar/ (Musical.notes and signs.here) bshags pa lhu re sbyar/ ( lhag ma spar gnas/ sngags tshig yan rnga bkyags/ dam tshig 'brel rjes su byin rlabs spyi ltar mar gnas/ ḍā tu bcad/ bcas btang*/ ) drang ba/ lhag ma spyi ltar/ phud skong*/ gzu dpang*/ spyi bskul/ sgos bskul bcas/ khro rol bsad pa las bcu'i/ e badz+ra maṇ+ḍal= nas/ ( dgu brdung*/ ) 'gugs pa lan gsum rjes/ spyi ltar bden chung*/ ( dgu ) rtsa brgyud/ ( dgu brdung zor rta/ ) e yi tshogs kyi= nas/ lcags sam= 'gor phur thun mtshams bskul/ che mchog zhes pa kha bsgyur la/ lcags sam drag po'i= ( brtags/ ) yang dag= sogs gzhan rnams kha bsgyur la/ yungs dkar/ gshin rje la mda' thun/ rta mgrin la gri thun/ phur pa la phur thun/ ma mo la khrag thun/ bla ma rig 'dzin la dug thun/ mchod bstod la tshe thun/

drag sngags la rdo thun/ bka' bsdod la 'di nas cung zhig chad dam snyam/ 505)hūm̐:nga ni dug gsum= ( bsad brdung cha gnyis/ ) zhal stabs mthar/ ( rgyob sod dgu ) zhi bzlog ( rkang 'ur dgu ) khro rol bzlog chen/ ( dgu tshig ) phrin las kyi mtshams so sor/ nya bo'i snod| rtsa rgyud/ ( rgyob sod dgu ) hūm̐:dug lnga= nas/ nga las ltos: bar phur gdab ni/ yon tan rgyud las= phur sngags bcas/ mtshams med lnga las= nas/ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ bar/ gris gtub ni/ ( zor rta/ ) hūm̐:che mchog sprul pa'i= nas/ phrin las mdzod= bar/ dmar sbreng*/ ( bsad brdung cha ya/ ) hūm̐:smug nag gru gsum= nas/ khā hiḥ bar/ zhal bstab/ hūm̐: che mchog yon tan= nas/ rol bar mdzod: rjes/ bzlog pa'i zhal bstab sbyor dgos/ ( dgu gdan/ ) gtor ma/ hūm̐:'jig rten= nas/ kha hiḥ bar/ bcol btad/ hūm̐:che mchog= nas/ mdzod: bar/ bh+yo gdab/ hūm̐:nga ni= nas/ bh+yo: bar/ ( rgyob sod dgu brdung*/ ) gzhan rnams rigs 'gres/ ( khyung*/ bka' bsdod kyi mtshams med 506) pa'i zor rta/ bsad brdung cha ya gyi gtub mthar bsad brdung cha gnyis/ ) che yon/ bden/ dril/ bzlog bong khyung dregs gsum sngar gsang rdzogs ltar/ nub mo/ dkar gtor/ ( dgu ) rtsa brgyud/ ( rgyob sod dgu rdung*/ ) khro rol ltar chad tho ( dgu ) he pa'i bstan man spyi ltar/ bro mnan/ las byang*/ mchod bstod/ bshags pa*/ shes brjod/ smon lam/ 'dir ni gzugs dang= sogs/ hūm̐:dang po chos sku= nas bsdu ldang*/ shes par bya'o: bar/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor= sogs kyis grub bo/ ༈ grol nyin khro rol ltar mtha' bsdu na/ bong khyung dregs gsum mthar/ he pa'i/ 'og gzhi dur khrod= nas/ bden stobs brjod/ mthun rdzas byin rlabs sbyar la mtha' phud/ gsang rdzogs 'phyang gi sgo dbye/ ( sgo phye rta/ ) hūm̐:shar gyi sgo ma= dang*/ gong gi hūm̐:bde gshegs rgyal bas= dngos grub blang*/ gtor lha ye shes pa rnams mdun gyi nam mkha' badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa phaṭaḥ

gtor snod bhan+dha= ( dgu ) rtsa rgyud/ ( rgyob sod dgu ) spyi bskul bsdus pa/ hrām̐:zhi ba 507)lhun grub= dang*/ dam can spyi bskul/ hūm̐: rab 'jigs dur khrod= ( dgu brdung*/ ) dregs pa'i gsol bskul/ hūm̐:bcom ldan dregs pa= nas/ ( rgyob sod dgu ) mtha'as bar/ ༈ phyi sgor gser skyems/ ( sgo phyi rta/ ) dkar gtor/ ye thog ra dge bcas btang nas nang du log khro rol ltar/ chad tho/ ( dgu brdung*/ ) dregs pa'i dmag 'gyed/ ( dgu brdung*/ ) hūm̐:snang srid dregs pa'i= sogs dang*/ ( rgyob sod dgu rdung*/ ) sgrub khog gi chas gos/ ( dril tshag ) hūm̐:dam can spros= sogs dang*/ zor gyi che bskyed/ ( zor rta kho nas/ ) hūm̐:snang srid= sogs tshig bzhi dang*/ swa bha wa= stong pa nyid du= sogs gang rung 'don la/ sngags bzla bzhin ri khar phyin nas/ dkar gtor/ ( sgrer chen nam/ ) gsang rdzogs bzlog pa'i ( rkang 'ur dgu ) za lam/ ( rgyob sod dgu ) zor gyi gzu dpang ni/ e:bla ma dkon mchog= sogs nas/ ru mtshon phyor: ( rgyob sod dgu ) sogs bar/ mdun du nya bo'i= sogs dang ( dgu brdung*/ ) 'gugs pa gsum/ bden chung dgu/ rtsa rgyud/ 508) phur thun tshom bskul/ chos kyi dbyings nas= sogs nas/ rdo rje phur pa= sogs lhu gcig ( rgyob sod brdung cha gnyis/ ) yon sbyar/ zor rta ni/ hūm̐: drag po 'bar ba'i= sogs nas/ phyogs bzhi la 'gres/ rgyab tu phyang= ( rgyob sod bsad brdung cha ya/ ) bar dang*/ hūm̐:zor byung= sogs nas/ ( bar sngags rnams rol btab dgu ldan re nas/ ) ri li li bh+yo: ( rgyob sod brdung cha ya/ ) bh+yo:phen no phen no= ( dmod mgor rgyob sod bsad brdung cha gnyis/ ) nas/ mtha' bar ram chung ( rkang 'ur dgu ) ba'i tshab tu drang srog dmod pa sbyar bas zor 'phang*/ lhag chen chad tho rol chen brdung*/ rjes la he pa'i bstan ma/ oṃ āḥhūm̐:bcom ldan= sogs nas tshigs bcad mgor ( dgu ) bh+yo bh+yo= bar dang*/ bstan mchen mo=

sogs sbyar/ ( 'ur dgu brdung*/ ) bro 'gugs rjes/ spyi ltar/ hūm̐:cig ni ting 'dzin= sogs nas/ phaṭa swā hāḥ bar/ bdag cag mchog grub= sogs dang*/ lam du phyir lam bcad/ ༈ gsang rdzogs ltar mtha' bsdu bar/ bong khyung dregs gsum rjes/ 'phyang gi 509) sgo dbye/ dngos grub bskul pa/ chad tho/ ri khar phyin nas/ ( rkang 'ur dgu ) dkar gtor/ za lam/ ( rgyob sod dgu ) 'phyang gi gzu dpang*/ hūm̐:gzu dang dpang du= nas/ bskyed par mdzod: ( rgyob sod dag ) ུ bar/ brub bskyed/ mdun du nya bo= sogs/ ( dgu ) 'gugs pa gsum/ spyi ltar/ bden chung*/ rtsa rgyud rjes la 'phyang gi oṃ badz+ra tsan+ḍa= nas/ gnas su spor: ( rgyob sod dgu brdung cha ya/ ) bar/ las byang gi hūm̐: ma nyes dpang du= sogs nas/ ma ra ya rbad: ( bsad brdung cha gnyis/ ) dang*/ dmod sbyar na/ hūm̐:rdo rje slob dpon= sogs nas mtha' bar btang nas zor 'phang*/ chad tho rol chen/ las byang bzhin bstan ma/ bro mnan bya/ ༈ mdos stabs lugs byas na/ chas gos/ brub bskyed/ 'gugs pa rnams dang*/ phur thun mtsham bskul/ dmod bcas 'dor nas/ bro mnan mthar nyin snga ma ltar mtha' bsdu/ ༈ mnan pa byas na/ ( dgu ) brub bskyed/ 'gugs pa dang*/ spyi ltar bden chung*/ rtsa rgyud gsum/ phur thun/ rdo rje phur pa= lhu cig yan/ ( rgyob sod bsad brdung cha gnyis/ ) badz+ra pa ṇi= lan gsum/ ( rgyob sod dgu ) 'phyang gyi bro mnan 510) yongs rdzogs dang*/ ( bro mnan brdung*/ ) bgegs rigs stong phrag= sogs brjod/ nang du log nas/ rgyal rtags ni/ dbu la bde gshegs= sogs dang*/ dus gsum bde gshegs= sogs/ spyi bshags yig brgya bcas/ gral du khod nas/ ( 'ur gsum/ ) mchod bstod/ ( 'ur dgu 'ur sum brdung*/ ) tshe 'gugs man sngar ltar ro/ ༈ gri 'dul gtor bzlog dang sbrel na/ lhag ma zin nas/ bum bskyed ni/ badz+ra a mṛ= sogs nas/ ldeb dzar/ 'og min= sogs sbyar/ rgyas par zhi ba dpal dgu bka' sdod dang bcas pa'i bsnyen pa'o/

'bring po/ tsan+ḍa= bsdus pa drag sngags so lnga/ las bum/ badz+ra a mṛ= bcas/ a bhi ṣiñtsa= sbyar ba bzla/ sarba ta tha ga= sogs dang sngags bzla/ gong gi mchod bstod bya/ lha rnams snyoms par= sogs nas/ blta'o/ bar/ phud skong*/ spyi bskul dgos bskul bsad pa'i las bcu/ zhi zlog bcas zin nas/ mdzes brgyan gyi/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bha wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las= sogs nas/ rnam shes 'gugs pa lan gsum 511)me lha 'dug par bsgom/ bar gri 'dul gzhung las/ me lha'i rgyal po= ( 'ur gsum/ ) sogs/ spyan 'drangs nas/ oṃ mag+ne he ab bya'i= sogs kyis sngags nyer gcig tsam gyis yam shing*/ mar khu ( bdun re mtshams su 'ur dgu gdan re/ mar khu ) sogs rdzas rnams 'bul/ ( 'ur bdun/ ) bstod pa/ 'dod gsol/ ( bdun brdung gcig ) byed par gyur cig bar/ mdzes brgyan las/ me lha'i rgyal po= sogs nas/ be ya ram̐/ bar/ ( sum brdung*/ ) me lha'i 'gal dum zhig shar lhor bzhugs/ lha bskyed rgyas pa them med ltar dang*/ bsdu nas mdzes brgyan nang gi swa bha/ nas/ sa ma ya dza dzaḥ bar gzhung gi ( rkang 'ur gsum/ ) hūm̐/ dad pa dang ni= sogs nas/ sreg tu gsol/ bar/ rtsa sngags gsham du/ gnod byed gri sri gri gshed mā ra ya phaṭa dz+wa la raṃ kha hi sbyar ba'i yam shing bcu/ ( bcu re'i mtshams su 'ur dgu daran re dang rgyob sod byas kyang srol yod mthar/ rgyob sod dgu brdung*/ ) mar khu bcu/ rdzas spungs sum cu/ 512)( rkang 'ur dgu ) bzlog pa zhal bstab 'gong bar/ ( dgu ) brub bskyed/ e las gnam lcags= sogs dang*/ ( dgu ) mdzes brgyan gyi 'gugs pa gsum/ spyi ltar bden chug dgu rtsa rgyud gsum/ ( don bdun ) zhal bstab 'phro bzlog pa'i zhal bstab sbyar nas/

( rnga bkyags ) bh+yo gdab bar/ ( rgyob sod dgu brdung*/ ) gri 'dul gzhung gis/ hūm̐/ che mchog yab yum= sogs nas/ thams cad ma lus/ gri sri/ dul phreng*/ mda' gri ( mar tshig thung rnams bcad gzung an+ne 'bar ba rnga bkyags/ ) skye bar shog bar/ ar+ghaṃ= sogs kyi mchod/ ( 'ur dgu ) tshom bu dgu bstod/ skabs babs kyi shwa lo kas ( gnyis ) bstod/ ( dgu brdung*/ ) de'i 'gres kyis dpal brgyad bka' srung bcas/ ( bstod pa mthar dgu brdung*/ ) khyung bzlog ( dgu brdung*/ ) me lha'i gtang rag gi hūm̐/ ye shes klong yangs= dam rdzas bdud rtsi= me lha'i rgyal po 513)tshe 'das las kyi= oṃ ag+ne he ab bye= bcu tsam gyis sreg rdzas 'bul/ gzhung gi ( 'ur la/ ) tshangs pa 'jig rten= sogs kyis bstod/ ( bdun brdung gsum/ ) ma 'byor pa dang= sogs yig brgya/ mdzes brgyan gyi/ khyed kyi sems can= sogs nas/ don du byon/ ( 'ur chen bro mnan mtha' ltar bzhag thabs brdung*/ ) bar dang*/ ༈ 'dul dkar gab sprad na/ dang po rnam shes 'gugs pa ni/ 'dul dkar las/ skye ba nges pa'i= sogs nas/ pre duḥdza dzaḥ bar lan gsum/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ spyi bor oṃ= sogs nas/ gsang bar haḥ bar/ ༈ gnyis pa bgegs sbyong shing glud gtang ba ni/ sarba bagh+nin na ma sarba ta tha ga te bh+yo= sogs/ gsum/ sum bha ni= gsum/ ( glud rta/ ) glud ni srid pa= sogs nas/ myur du gshegs/ bar/ las byang bgegs sprad/ srung 'khor bcas btang*/ gsum pa las kun 'byung gi sdig pa bshags pa ni/ ( 'dul dkar rta/ ) stong gsum mun nag= sogs nas/ 514)( ḍa/ ) phaṭaḥ bar/ ༈ bzhi pa nyon mongs kun 'byung gi sgrib pa bkru ba ni/ ( byis sha mdo rta/ ) mkha' dbyings rnam dag= sogs nas/ sangs kyis song bar bsam/ ༈ lnga pa shes bya'i bag chags dug gam gri btul ba ni/ 'gro drug klu dang bcas pa'i sa bon thugs rje'i rlung gi sbyangs bar bsam zhing*/ ( 'dul dkar rta ) hūm̐/ dang po gri byung= sogs dang*/

( byis sha med rta/ ) 'dod yon lnga ldan= sogs kyis gtor ma btang*/ de'i 'gres kyi/ lha min/ klu/ mi/ byol song*/ yi dwags/ dmyal ba bcas nag 'gros sam go ldog kyang rung*/ dpal gyi thugs las 'bar ma brgyad kyis mes bsregs par bsam zhing*/ ( 'dul dkar rta/ ) hūm̐/ dang po gri byung= sogs dang*/ ( 'dul du gsol rnams la dril tshag 'thig ba ltar gri lcags brdung*/ ) bdud rtsi'i char gyis bkrus te gsol bar bsam zhing*/ hūm̐/ 'byung ba chen po= sogs nas/ rgyal por shog bar/ 'og ma gnyis 'gro ba bdun la re re nas sbyar kyang rung*/ de dag gis ni tshogs sbyor dang mthun par 'gal rkyen 515) bsal ba'o/ ༈ drug pa mthong lam dang 'dra bar dkyil 'khor dug zhug pa ni/ skye nges pa'i= sogs nas/ longs spyod rol= bar/ ༈ bdun pa sgom lam dang mtshungs par 'dod yon tshogs su 'bul ba ni/ ( byi'u sha me rta/ ) bshos dang gal phye= nas/ gyur cig bar/ gsur bsngo bya/ ༈ brgyad pa mthar lam chos skur gnas spar ba ni/ ( bye 'u sha med rta/ ) lag pa'i sor mo= nas/ sal gyi gyur/ ༈ dgu pa gzugs sku'i phrin las la smon lam 'debs pa/ dkon mchog gsum gyi= nas/ 'phrad par shog bar brjod pas mthun rkyen sgrub pa'o/ ༈ grol nyin 'dul nag mthar me lha btang rag mi bya bar/ hom bdun sregs te me 'gal der gzhug de nas me lha gtang rag sngar lta bya/ ( sum brdung*/ ) hūm̐/ ye shes klong yangs= rdzas 'bul ( 'ur bdun brdung*/ ) tshangs pa 'jig rten= mthar/ ( bdun brdung gsum/ ) mdzes brgyan gyi/ 'jag gzugs me dbus bkod/ gson cig tshe 'das= sogs nas/ shan+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ bar dang*/ zab mdo'i/ gzugs stong pa'o= sogs nas/ ( rnga re re tsam rgyeb srod yod/ ) sangs rgyas so/ bar/ 'phags mchog thugs rje= 516) gzungs sngags dang*/ ( rnga 'don/ ) ma 'byor pa dang= yig brgya/ khyed kyi sems can= sogs nas/ don la byon= ( bzhags thabs brdung*/

sgrol gri/ 'gugs g.yab/ ru mtshon nag po'am/ skam thun/ rdo thun/ yungs thun/ rnga nag bcol gtad nas/ rlon thun/ dug khrag gi snod lcags zangs la sogs/ gang bder bde gshegs zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ bum pa/ me long*/ gri skyabs mchod brten/ 'gro ba bdun gyi dal/ lan chags gtor ma bdun/ 'dod yon glud/ zhi sbyang gsum/ phyed ma gsum/ mda' gzhu/ 'jag ma'i glud gzugs rma bya'i sgro/ sman bzang bcas so// 519) ༄༅/ zhi 'dul dang lcags 'dul las 'grigs bzhugs so/ zhi khro la lcags 'dul gab sprad nas 'don 'grigs ni/ sde bskang mthar/ sum brdung*/ lcags 'dul ni 'dul chas byin rlabs/ rkang 'ur gsum/ spyan 'dren/ mchod/ 'ur rkang dgu bstod/ 'phros 'ur rkang dgu/ zhi khro'i bskul ba/ rnam dag chos dbyings= zhi khro'i/ dgu thing*/ bka' dang dam tshig= dgu/ sde bskul bcas/ rgyob sod dgu/ gser skyems/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud= kha bsgyur/ hūm̐ bh+yo: 'gro don= rang gdangs sam gzu rta/ bsam pa sgrubs: bar/ lcags 'dul gyi brub bskyed/ dgu 'gugs pa spyi ltar/ bden chung*/ rtsa brgyud/ rgyob sod dgu thing*/ hūm̐ bh+yo: mi 520)mngon= nas/ grogs la byon: bar/ dgu lcags 'dul/ hūm̐/ bskal pa me= nas/ yan lag bsdom= rgyob sod/ dgu gshed 'gugs/ hūm̐/ dpal chen= sogs/ rang gzugs/ ḍā 'phar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bar dgu thing*/ zhi khro'i/ khrag 'thung sku yi= nas/ khug cig: 'jam 'ur/ dgu thing*/ lcags 'dul/ hūm̐/ steng gi phyogs= sogs/ dgra chos ltar ḍā bkyags/ rgyob sod dgu gdan re/ khug nas dgu rdung rjes/ bzlog rdung*/ za bsod bskul ba mtha' bar/ rgyob sod/ dgu zhi khro'i/ hūm̐:khrag thung las= nas/ phral bar gyis shig: bar/ 'jam 'ur/ dgu thing*/ lcags 'dul/ za 'dre shi gshed= nas/ gzu rta/ phye phye/ bar/ dgu thing*/ zhi khro'i/ khrag 'thung yon tan= nas/ gson pa'i dus= nas sogs ḍā 'phar/ za 'dre shi gshed= sa ma ya dza dzaḥ rgyob sod/

dgu thing*/ zhi khro'i/ khrag 'thung gsung= nas/ gyis shig 'jam 'ur/ dgu thing*/ 521) lcags 'dul/ hūm̐/ nga ni dpal chen= nas/ ha la hūm̐ phaṭaḥ rgyob sod dgu thing*/ zhi khro'i/ khrag 'thung phrin las= nas/ chug cig: 'jam 'ur dgu thing*/ lcags 'dul/ hūm̐/ lcags sam drag po'i= nas/ zor rta/ za 'dre ma ra ya phaṭaḥ bar/ rgyob sod bsad rdung ya/ zhi khro'i/ hūm̐ bh+yo: phog par rgyob= nas/ rang gdangs sam hrug dbang phyug rnams= bar/ dgu/ lcags 'dul/ hūm̐/ gser phye= nas/ sha tri ni hūm̐ dza/ bar/ rgyob sod bsad brdung cha gnyis/ zhi khro'i/ hūm̐ bh+yo: dang po'i sangs rgyas= rang gdangs sam hrug tsit+ta la kha hiḥ bar/ 'jam 'ur dgu/ lcags 'dul/ e las gnam lcags= de yang gshed kyi ḍā 'phar/ sngags nyer gcig rgyob sod dgu/ brub khung nang du= sngags brgya tsam/ ma ra ya rbadaḥ bar/ rgyob sod dgu 'am/ bro mnan/ ḍā/ zhi khro'i tshogs drang ba/ lhag ma bcas sngar srol ltar btang*/ bzlog pa spro na/ rol bsu bcas 'ur dgu brdung*/ bka' brgyad bde gshegs zhi bzlog dgu/ 522) gsang rdzogs kyi yan lag bzlog pa/ hūm̐: bcom ldan dpal chen badz+ra he ru ka: lhu gcig btang*/ kha hiḥ bar/ rgyob sod dgu rdung*/ 'dul nag thun phyi ma rnams/ 'ur dgu brdung gis/ gzhung rgyug bya/ 'dul dkar sngar ltar/ nub snga ma rnams su/ dkar rtsa/ chad bstan nas mthar dbyungs/ ༈ grol nyin/ bla rdel bskyel 'phros/ dkar gtor/ dgu/ rtsa brgyud/ rgyob sod dgu/ zhi khro'i las byang che chung bskul pa/ bar 'dir dpyod/ dgu thing*/ pho nya/ sde bskul 'gor dgu mthar bdun thing*/ chad tho/ bdun thing*/ sgo dbye/ hūm̐ dzaḥshar phyogs= nas/ byang phyogs kyi/ zor lam dgra la bsgyur: yan/ 'dul gyi zor sngar ltar dang*/ zhi khro'i zor/ rgyob sod bsad rdung cha gnyis/ hūm̐:phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad= nas/ 'grub par mdzod: bar zor 'phang*/ rgyob sod/ brtan ma'i rnga/ brtan ma btang*/ chad tho spyi ltar/

lcags 'dul gyi sbyin bsreg sngar ltar/ 523) spyan 'dren/ 'ur gsum/ rdzas la 'ur dgu gdan/ mchod pa'i mthar 'ur dgu/ tshar dus gsum rdung*/ mnan pa bya sar/ dkar gtor brub bskyed/ phaṭaḥ.e las lcags khang= sogs nas/ de'i nang du= bar/ gong gi ling ga tri= sogs nas/ dgu/ 'gugs pa/ spyi ltar bden chung*/ rtsa brgyud/ phur gdab/ lcags sam= zor rta/ thun rdeg rgyob sod bsad brdung ya/ gser phye= sogs/ rgyob sod bsad rdung cha gnyis/ ma rig gshed= nyer gcig rgyob sod dgu/ sngags gsum bcas/ brub khung nang= sogs/ sngags brgya tsam/ rgyob sod dgu/ badz+ra pa ṇi= gsum/ 'phros/ rgyob sod dgu/ 'dul 'phro'i bro dang*/ zhi khro'i bro sbyar/ bro mnan spyi ltar/ bgegs rigs= sogs brjod/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus dang*/ bdag nyid spyi gtsug= man mthar dbyung bas legs par grub bo// grub dbang dpal chen 'dus pa'i phyag mchan las zhal 524) bshus so/ ༄༅/ lcags 'dul 'don lugs ni/ lha gzhung phur pa'i lhag ma rtsang gyer yan grub nas/ lcags 'dul gzhung gi oṃ swa bha wa= stong pa'i ngang= sogs nas/ 'dul chas byin rlabs/ gzu dpang rta/ rol bsu/ 'ur sum rdung*/ spyan 'dren/ mchod/ 'ur dgu rdung*/ bstod/ 'ur dgu/ brub bskyed/ bdun/ 'gugs pa gsum/ spyi ltar bden chung dgu rtsa brgyud gsum/ pho nya bskul pa'i/ yan lag sdom= rgyob sod dgu/ gshed 'gugs/ hūm̐/ dpal chen thugs= sogs/ rang gzugs ming byang la rnga bkyags/ mtha' bar/ gzhung gi hūm̐/ steng gi phyogs= sogs nas/ za bsod bskul pa gnyis re'i mtshams/ bkugs nas phyin dgra chos ltar rnga bkyags/ rgyob sod dgu gdan re/ khug na dgu brdung man bzlog brdung mthar/ rgyob sod dgu lha dbye/ dgu bsad bskul/ rnga bkyags/ sngags gsum re/ rgyob sod dgu bsgral ba/ dgu brdung*/ phur gdab/ grol nyin zor 'don/ bsad brdung cha ya/ thun rdeg 525) bsad brdung cha gnyis/ brtson du bzung ba/

de yang gshed= rnga bkyags/ brub khung 'go rgyob sod dgu/ thun dang po rnams la brub khung 'gor dgu brdung*/ mthar rgyob sod dgu sngags gong ma tshar gsum re/ 'og ma brgya'am nyer gcig e hur thu ma dza sa ma ya rbad= bro mnan/ rnga/ des thun dang po grub bo/ thun phyi ma rnams/ rang nyid yi dam= nas 'ur dgu rdung gis btang*/ gshed 'gugs dor ba'i snga ma ltar bya/ ༈ 'dul dkar ni/ skad cig gis rang nyid yi dam= nas/ 'dul dkar rta/ 'gugs pa/ mgron btsugs/ glud/ glud rta/ chos bshad/ zas bsngo rta/ byang gdan/ bsngo ba/ khrus dar/ mar me/ ja chang*/ phye mar/ dkar gsum/ sogs bsngo ba mthar gsur bsngo bya/ de ring phyin chad= nas/ 'bras/ khyung*/ gos/ ༈ rta lug bcas bsngo ba dang*/ lam bstan mthar bzang spyod sogs bsngo smon ci rigs bya/ nub snga ma rnams su las byang mtha' bsdu/ ༈ grol nyin lam bstan mthar 526) bla ma rgyang 'bod/ gzungs sngags kyis nri byang bsreg smon lam rnams mthar/ dmigs yul tshe las 'das pa'i bla sogs nas/ dharma ka ya= bar gyis bla rdel dud khrod du bskyal/ lha gzhung*/ sgo dbye/ bskul pa/ dngos grub bcas/ phyi sgo gser skyems/ chad tho/ dkar gtor/ rol bsu/ 'ur dgu/ za lam/ rgyob sod dgu/ gzu dpang bcas/ rgyob sod dgu/ 'dul nag gi phaṭaḥ e las lcags kyi= sogs nas/ de'i nang du= bar/ gong gi liṅga triḥljang sngon= sogs nas/ 'gugs pa gsum/ spyi ltar/ bden chung dgu rtsa brgyud gsum/ gong gi hūm̐/nga ni dpal chen= sogs/ tshig gsum kun la sbyar bas/ phyogs phyogs= la ḍā 'phar/ mtha' nas/ hūm̐/ 'og phyogs sa bdag 'dul ba'i thugs dam bskul// dmar gyi gtor ma= sogs/ dbang du= ḍā 'phar/ rdul du brlog bar/ 'og gi khro bcu'i 'og phyogs pa'i sngags brjod/ 'ur dgu gtan re/ hūm̐/ byang shar= sogs nas kha bsgyur gong ltar la/ rdul du rlog 527) bar/ 'og gi byang shar bar sngags brjod/ hūm̐/ nub byang= sogs/ rdul du rlog

bar/ 'og gi nub byang sngags/ hūm̐/ lho nub= sogs nas sngags bcas de'i 'gros kyi/ shar lho/ byang*/ nub/ lho/ shar/ steng bcas 'phang*/ hūm̐/ nga ni dpal chen= sogs nas tshig gsum 'phros/ hūm̐/ ye shes khro bo= sogs nas/ rlog bar 'og gi sngags/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ma hā kro dha bhi sha tsakra ma dha la ha la ha la hūm̐ phaṭaḥ

rgyob sod bsad rdung cha ya/ lha gzhung las byang zor/ nga ni rdo rje= bsad brdung cha gnyis/ gsog med nges pa'i= chad tho'i rol chen/ brtan ma/ 'ur dgu lcags 'dul sbyin bsreg swa bha wa= sogs/ spyan 'dren mgor 'ur sum rdung*/ bhur kur sngags ring lnga bcu bar du 'ur dgu gdan re/ sngags thung gsham sbyar lnga bcu bcas/ ar+ghaṃ= 'ur dgu sngon tshe= nas/ badz+ra muḥ yan/ mnan pa ma byas na/ bro 'gugs gsum rjes/ lcags 'dul bro dang*/ phur pa'i bro sbyar/ rnga spyi ltar/ mnan pa 528) byas tshe/ dkar gtor/ brub bskyed zor ltar/ dgu 'gugs pa gsum/ spyi ltar/ bden chung dgu/ rtsa brgyud gsum/ mthar phur gdab/ zor rta/ lcags sam drag po'i= rgyob sod bsad brdung ya/ rkyang pa'am/ zab gnad byas na/ thun rdeg gser phye= sogs/ rgyob sod bsad brdung gnyis/ ma rig gshed= sngags nyer gcig rgyob sod dgu/ brub khung nang du= sngags brgya tsam bcas sbyar rjes/ badz+ra pa ṇi= gsum/ rgyob sod dgu/ lcags 'dul bro dang phur pa'i bro sbyar nas bro mnan brdung*/ bgegs rigs= sogs brjod la zhi khro la sbyar na/ lhag ma'i mthar/ 'dul nag lan grangs rjes/ 'dul dkar tshar re/ grol nyin zor/ sbyin sreg mnan pa bcas sbyar nas/ dkar gtor/ rtsa brgyud/ bskul/ chad bstan nas mthar dbyung bas grub bo/ ༈ yang zhi khro'i gnas 'dren dang 'dul dkar gnyis 'brel tshe/ dang po gnas 'dren la/ phyogs bcu na= sogs/ sa ma ya lhan: 529) bar/ 'dul dkar las/ skad cig gis= sogs/ a mu ka sid+dhi hūm̐/ bar/ gnas 'dren nas/ tshe 'das rnam shes a yig= sogs/ rak+ṣa hūm̐: bar 'dul dkar las/ oṃ a mṛ te= sogs/ saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ bar/ gnas 'dren nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ na ma sarba= sogs/ ta ye swa hā: 'dul dkar/ sangs rgyas rkang gnyis= sogs/ phrin las mdzod/ bar gnas 'dren nas/ hūm̐: nga nyid lha yi= sogs/ zas bsngo byin rlabs/ 'dod yon bsngo ba/ sa ye swa hā/ yan/ 'dul dkar las/

hūm̐/ srid rtse mi snang= sogs lam bstan gong bar/ gnas 'dren las/ kye ma:tshe 'das= sogs mthar rdzogs par bya/ de nas bde smon gang nus 'don/ 'dul dkar las/ tshe las 'das pa cho ge mo'i bla= sogs/ ka ya= bar/ hūm̐ hrīḥphyogs bcu'i rgyal ba= sogs lan gsum byas bas grub bo/ gur drag me 'khyil la lcags 'dul sbyar na phur par sbyar pa dang 'dra 'o// 530) ( Diagram here )
